summary: PJM answers the September 8 limited protests of Constellation, AMP and industrial customers to its August 17 co-location compliance filing, defending the July 1, 2028 Interim NITS date and agreeing to two clarifications in its November filing.
ask: Grant leave to answer and accept the answer and the Pilong affidavit, and consider deferring the contested tariff issues until PJM's November compliance filing builds a fuller record.

points.point: PJM suggests FERC may defer the contested issues until its November compliance filing.
points.quote: it may be appropriate for the Commission to defer consideration of these issues until it has the benefit of a complete record following next month’s compliance filing.

points.point: PJM expects systems to accept requests for the new services in September 2027, after the changes needed for Interim NITS.
points.quote: PJM anticipates modifying the systems needed to begin accepting requests for the new transmission services in September of 2027.

points.point: PJM is designing a unified cluster study of large loads and generation, to be filed on or before November 16, 2026 in response to E-7.
points.quote: PJM is developing a proposal for a new a study process that would evaluate large loads and generation interconnection requests together in a unified cluster study that would take roughly a year to complete.

points.point: PJM gives a timeline running from a 2027 application window to service in the first quarter of 2029.
points.quote: application process in September of 2027, conducting the study in 2028, and beginning to provide service in first quarter 2029.

points.point: PJM says it will not repeat Necessary Studies already done, though changed scope can trigger more study.
points.quote: While PJM will not repeat studies already performed, project scope or other technical changes may trigger the need for additional study.

points.point: PJM answers Constellation that Interim NITS will be interruptible and curtailed before capacity-backed services.
points.quote: Interim NITS will be interruptible and curtailed before firm services like Firm Contract Demand Service or NITS that are capacity-backed services.

points.point: PJM will clarify in November that load with behind-the-meter generation is excluded from the Co-Located Load definition.
points.quote: PJM intends to propose clarifications to the definition of BTMG in the November compliance filing to specify that load with BTMG is excluded from the definition of Co-Located Load.

points.point: PJM does not object to AMP's proposed fix to the Eligible Generating Facility definition.
points.quote: PJM, does not object to AMP’s proposed revision to Eligible Generating Facility definition set forth in its pleading.

throughLine.text: Defends PJM's E-2 co-location compliance, including the Interim NITS timeline, and previews the unified large load study PJM will file by November 16 in response to the E-7 show cause order.
